definitions.explanation: Describes something covering a surface completely with no gaps, often used for writing, patterns, or things arranged closely together.

examples.japanese: ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧びっしり⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The notebook is covered with densely written text.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧びっしり⟦ポスター→ポスター：09598_posutaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{貼|は}られている→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: The wall is completely covered with posters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧びっしり⟦{額|ひたい}→額：03579_hitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かんでいる→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: Sweat is covering his forehead completely.

notes:
びっしり is a mimetic adverb describing a surface being covered completely and densely, with no gaps or empty space. It emphasizes two-dimensional coverage.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- びっしり⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write densely, fill a page with writing
- びっしり⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to be lined up closely together
- びっしり⟦{埋|う}め{尽|つ}くす→埋め尽くす：17206_umetsukusu⟧: to fill up completely
- びっしり⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to cover a surface with stickers/posters

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- びっしり: dense surface coverage (writing on paper, posters on a wall, sweat on skin)
- ⟦ぎっしり→ぎっしり：05891_gisshiri⟧: packed full in a space (books in a bag, people in a room — three-dimensional)
- ⟦ぎゅうぎゅう→ぎゅうぎゅう：05646_gyuugyuu⟧: stuffed, crammed (stronger than ぎっしり, implies uncomfortable pressure)

TYPICAL SUBJECTS:
⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧ (text), ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧ (sweat), ⟦ポスター→ポスター：09598_posutaa⟧ (posters), ⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧ (schedule — figuratively 'packed').
